#### Box Plots by Factors {#sec-ppc-522}

[**Initial Steps**]{#sec-ppc-522-initial-steps}

The initial step is to plot [box plots](../01-eda/index.qmd#sec-eda-box-plot) of the measured diameter for each of the explanatory variables.

[**Box Plot by Machine**]{#sec-ppc-522-boxplot-machine}

The following is a [box plot](../01-eda/index.qmd#sec-eda-box-plot) of the diameter by machine.

```{r}
#| code-fold: true
#| label: fig-ppc-522-boxplot-machine
#| fig-cap: "Box plot of diameter by machine"
ggplot(machine_data, aes(machine, diameter)) +
  geom_boxplot(fill = "steelblue", alpha = 0.5) +
  geom_hline(yintercept = mean(machine_data$diameter), linetype = "dashed", color = "grey40") +
  labs(x = "Machine", y = "Diameter (inches)") +
  theme_light()
```

[**Conclusions From Box Plot**]{#sec-ppc-522-boxplot-machine-conclusions}

We can make the following conclusions from this box plot.

1. The location appears to be significantly different for the three machines, with machine 2 having the smallest median diameter and machine 1 having the largest median diameter.
2. Machines 1 and 2 have comparable variability while machine 3 has somewhat larger variability.

[**Box Plot by Day**]{#sec-ppc-522-boxplot-day}

The following is a [box plot](../01-eda/index.qmd#sec-eda-box-plot) of the diameter by day.

```{r}
#| code-fold: true
#| label: fig-ppc-522-boxplot-day
#| fig-cap: "Box plot of diameter by day"
ggplot(machine_data, aes(day, diameter)) +
  geom_boxplot(fill = "steelblue", alpha = 0.5) +
  geom_hline(yintercept = mean(machine_data$diameter), linetype = "dashed", color = "grey40") +
  labs(x = "Day", y = "Diameter (inches)") +
  theme_light()
```

[**Conclusions From Box Plot**]{#sec-ppc-522-boxplot-day-conclusions}

We can draw the following conclusion from this box plot. Neither the location nor the spread seem to differ significantly by day.

[**Box Plot by Sample Number**]{#sec-ppc-522-boxplot-sample}

The following is a [box plot](../01-eda/index.qmd#sec-eda-box-plot) of the sample number.

```{r}
#| code-fold: true
#| label: fig-ppc-522-boxplot-sample
#| fig-cap: "Box plot of diameter by sample number"
ggplot(machine_data, aes(sample, diameter)) +
  geom_boxplot(fill = "steelblue", alpha = 0.5) +
  geom_hline(yintercept = mean(machine_data$diameter), linetype = "dashed", color = "grey40") +
  labs(x = "Sample Number", y = "Diameter (inches)") +
  theme_light()
```

[**Conclusion From Box Plot**]{#sec-ppc-522-boxplot-sample-conclusions}

We can draw the following conclusion from this box plot. Although there are some minor differences in location and spread between the samples, these differences do not show a noticeable pattern and do not seem significant.
